message.name: AIRBOUND_PARAMETER_GETSET
message.description: Custom Airbound Parameter GET SET API for setting or getting a simple parameter.
message.field: system id of the target
component ID of the target
Identifier for the custom parameter.
Action to perform (GET or SET).
Value to set (ignored for GET action).

message.name: AIRBOUND_PARAMETER_STATUS
message.description: Status and value feedback for a custom Airbound parameter.
message.field: Identifier for the custom parameter from the request.
The current value of the parameter.
Result of the operation.

message.name: AIRBOUND_FLIGHT_INFORMATION
message.description: Flight timing information with UTC timestamps for arming, takeoff, landing, and disarming events.
message.field: Timestamp (time since system boot).
UTC timestamp of last arming event, retained after landing and disarm.
UTC timestamp of last takeoff.
UTC timestamp of last landing. Only set by the landing detector during auto-mission VTOL landings.
UTC timestamp of last disarming event.
Elapsed flight time since takeoff.

message.name: AIRBOUND_LINK_STATS
message.description: MAVLink traffic counters for the link this message is sent on, cumulative since boot. Difference two messages to get per-interval values.
message.field: Timestamp (time since system boot).
Frames received whose target_system is this vehicle.
Frames received whose target_system is a different vehicle, i.e. misrouted to this link.
Frames received with target_system 0 or no target field.
Sequence gaps in frames addressed to this vehicle or broadcast, tracked per sender. Only meaningful if the sender numbers each vehicle's frames separately.
Frames addressed to this vehicle or broadcast that repeated or went back on the sender's sequence number: a sender whose sequence never increments, or a duplicated or late frame.
Frames of a known message type that failed the CRC check (damaged or truncated).
Frames of a message type this vehicle does not know, so the CRC could not be checked.
Frames sent by this vehicle on this link.
Times a message was not sent because the link's send buffer was full.

message.name: AIRBOUND_LINK_SENDER
message.description: Receive counters for one sender (GCS) on the link this message is sent on, cumulative since that sender was first seen. One message per sender heard on the link in the last 10 s, up to 4 per link. Sent every AB_LNK_SENDER seconds; not sent when AB_LNK_SENDER is 0.
message.field: Timestamp (time since system boot).
System ID of the sender these counters are for.
Component ID of the sender these counters are for.
Frames received from this sender that were addressed to this vehicle or broadcast.

Sequence gaps in this sender's frames, i.e. frames lost on the way. Only meaningful if the sender numbers each vehicle's frames separately. A jump of 128 or more, or a return after 60 s of silence, is not counted.
Frames that repeated or went back on this sender's sequence number: a sender whose sequence never increments, or a duplicated or late frame.
Sequence number of the last frame received from this sender.
